instruction: Calculate approximate beam deflection for a 1000mm span under 500N central load (steel, simple beam).
input: Span L=1000mm, load P=500N. Material: generic steel (grade requires review). Formula: delta = P*L³/(48*E*I). Assumption: simple beam, rectangular cross-section 20x30mm.
output: I = bh³/12 = 20*(30)³/12 = 45000 mm⁴. E ≈ 200 GPa = 200000 N/mm². delta ≈ 500*(1000)³/(48*200000*45000) ≈ 1.16 mm (approx). REQUIRES REVIEW: exact E grade, cross-section, boundary conditions.
source_notes: Standard beam formula verified; material grade and geometry details require verified source.
